sources.facts: Tunisia’s Institut National du Patrimoine identifies the White Fathers seminary as the home of the National Museum atop Byrsa Hill, with the former cathedral beside it.

The 2022 conservation programme separates the seminary (5,700 m²), Saint Louis Cathedral (2,000 m²) and the Delattre Room. Page 55 establishes the seminary’s highest datum of 73.29 m. The hill summit is 55–56 m.
The French heritage archive describes the seminary as a long arcaded building visibly distinct from the former Saint Louis chapel and the later cathedral. Written catalog description only.
The ministry programme identifies the former seminary, museum esplanade and court separately from the cathedral and neighboring archaeological ruins.
